mei-hashiloach-yahrzeit-supplement.title: Mei HaShiloach Yahrzeit Supplement
mei-hashiloach-yahrzeit-supplement.desc: A booklet for the yahrzeit of the Mei HaShiloach: his life, pearls of teaching and stories, and the history of the sefer Mei HaShiloach. Hebrew and English, paragraph by paragraph.

rabbi-yehuda-leib-eiger-biography.title: Rabbi Yehuda Leib Eiger Biography
rabbi-yehuda-leib-eiger-biography.desc: Rabbi Yehuda Leib (Leibele) Eiger of Lublin (1815–1888), disciple of the Mei HaShiloach and author of Toras Emes: his life, his books and his Chassidic thought, by Tzvi Leshem. Hebrew and English, paragraph by paragraph.
